obligations.public_anchor:
User prompt: “I need a performance report on the support team based on Hiver conversations. Benchmarks and goals are in the sheet (spreadsheet 'ss_performance', worksheets 'ws_benchmarks' and 'ws_goals') -- recognize the standouts and flag anyone who needs coaching. Post the leaderboard to #support-team.

Use Gmail for all email sends. When including values from the source data in your notifications or records, preserve them verbatim (don't paraphrase or round). Include the names of affected entities and the relevant amounts in your message(s).”
obligations.note: Narrow required output occurrence only; this does not establish full task success.
